name: Flat dish
summary: Flat dish or bowl of food: plate, bowl, pan, board or basket with soup, rice, noodles, salad, chips or fruit and steam.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the vessel rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the dish is hero size (~420 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: vessel
params.note: bowl and deepbowl seen from the front, slightly above; pan has a handle; board = cutting board; cup = steel katori

params.name: vesselColor
params.note: default depends on vessel (white, steel, wood, dark pan)

params.name: rimColor
params.note: inside or rim colour; default depends on vessel

params.name: fill
params.note: liquid = soup, curry; mound = rice; grains; strands = noodles; chunks; leafy = salad; pieces = chips above rim; balls = piled round items

params.name: fillColor2
params.note: accent: chunks, pieces, garnish or broth colour (default depends on fill)

params.name: garnish
params.note: egg = halved soft egg for ramen; herbs = green sprigs

params.name: steam
params.note: three steam curls rising and fading

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
